sources.title: Dorking Battery Energy Storage System, UK
paragraphs: The Dorking Battery Energy Storage System is a 6 MW / 6 MWh operational electro-chemical battery facility situated at Milton Court Farm, off Milton Court Lane in Dorking (RH4 3LY), adjacent to the local substation area.

Developed by Grid Battery Storage Limited (GBSL) in partnership with Siemens and Statkraft, the installation uses lithium-ion storage technology to provide frequency response, peak shaving, and balancing services to the local and national grid.

sources.title: Cobham Road Solar Park granted planning permission after successful appeal
paragraphs: The 49.5 MW Cobham Road Solar Park was granted planning permission on appeal following a five-day public inquiry conducted by the Planning Inspectorate at the Mole Valley District Council chamber in Pippbrook, Dorking.

The utility-scale solar application had initially been refused by Mole Valley District Council's planning committee in April 2025, overturning officer recommendations. The Inspector ruled that national clean power priorities and substantial renewable energy benefits outweighed localized impacts.

sources.title: Energy storage facility planning application – Ashtead / Leatherhead
paragraphs: A planning application (MO/2024/1544) was submitted to Mole Valley District Council for a 98 MW battery energy storage system (BESS) facility, underground cabling, security fencing, and associated infrastructure on land northwest of Barnett Wood Lane.

The development connects across district boundaries to the Chessington electricity substation and prompted extensive community feedback, including objections regarding Green Belt impact and proximity to the Ashtead Common Site of Special Scientific Interest (SSSI).

sources.title: Kingston council approves 98MW BESS
paragraphs: Planning approval was awarded for cross-boundary grid transmission works facilitating a 98 MW battery energy storage system connecting Mole Valley District Council and the Royal Borough of Kingston upon Thames.
Part of a major portfolio developed by Bluestone Energy and acquired by Eku Energy, the system delivers grid flexibility and storage capacity across the north Mole Valley and wider Surrey network.
